note: Per-brand facts for the US-regulated profiles, each read off the brand's OWN pages on the date given — never a review site. Same group/fact shape as casinoSpecSheets.json: label, value in the brand's own words or figures, the page it came from. A brand with no entry here still gets its profile from the regulators' lists; this file adds what the regulators do not say — the offer, who can play, how to sign up, the library.
